FINAL: [headscale ]

LINE: headscale users |
LISTED: [headscale users  / create  (Create a local user)  get     (Show one user)        list    (List the users)       set     (Change a local user)   / $ headscale users ]
FINAL: [headscale users ]

LINE: headscale users list --|
LISTED: [headscale users list -- / --columns       (Columns to show: a list, or +name and -name to change the default)  --list-columns  (List the columns, the API field behind each, and exit) / --config        (Config file)                                                        --output        (Output format: json (the API object)) / --filter        (Keep the rows that match; may be repeated)                          --sort          (Column to sort by; -name sorts in reverse) / --help          (Show this help)                                                      / $ headscale users list --]
FINAL: [headscale users list --]

LINE: headscale users list --columns id,na|
LISTED: [headscale users list --columns id,na\,name]
FINAL: [headscale users list --columns id\,name]

LINE: headscale users list --columns +lo|
LISTED: [headscale users list --columns +login-name ]
FINAL: [headscale users list --columns +login-name ]

LINE: headscale users list --sort -co|
LISTED: [headscale users list --sort -count ]
FINAL: [headscale users list --sort -count ]

LINE: headscale users list --filter=pro|
LISTED: [headscale users list --filter=pro / profile-pic-url  provider         provider-id       / $ headscale users list --filter=pro]
FINAL: [headscale users list --filter=pro]

LINE: headscale users set alice --|
LISTED: [headscale users set alice -- / --config        (Config file)                            --help          (Show this help)                         --picture-url   (New profile picture URL; "" clears it) / --display-name  (New display name; "" clears it)         --name          (New username)                            / --email         (New email address; "" clears it)        --output        (Output format: json (the API object))    / $ headscale users set alice --]
FINAL: [headscale users set alice --]
